description: In the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), add a new CNAME DNS record to the 'acmecorp.test' domain. The CNAME record should have: Name = 'blog' (which will resolve as 'blog.acmecorp.test'), Value/Target = 'acmecorp.test.' (with a trailing dot, indicating a fully qualified domain name), and use the default TTL. Navigate to the acmecorp.test virtual server in the left panel, then go to 'DNS Records' and add the new record.
